title: 求职被拒后，礼貌地要反馈
title_en: Asking for Feedback After a Job Rejection
summary_zh: 面试没通过，还能做什么？这封邮件示范怎样不卑不亢地请对方给几点反馈：不质疑结果，又为下一次机会留了门。读完你能写一封得体的“请求反馈”邮件。
body: Dear Ms Patel, thank you for letting me know the outcome of my application for the junior designer position. Although I was disappointed not to be offered the role, I really enjoyed meeting the team and hearing about your current projects. I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to share some feedback on my interview. I understand how busy you are, so even two or three short points would be very helpful. In particular, I would like to know whether my portfolio gave you a clear picture of what I can do. I was also unsure about my answer to the question on working to tight deadlines, and I wonder if it came across the way I intended. To be clear, I am asking because I want to improve before my next interview, not because I want to question your decision. If it is easier for you, I would be happy to have a ten-minute call at a time that suits you. Whatever you decide, I appreciate the time you have already given me. I will keep following your studio's work with interest. If a similar position opens up in the future, I hope you will consider me again. Thank you once more for the chance to meet you. Best regards, Lena Fischer

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Lena's email?
options: To ask the company to change its decision
To ask for feedback that will help her improve
To apply for a different position at the studio
To complain about how the interview was organised
questions.evidence: I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to share some feedback on my interview.

questions.prompt: Why does Lena write "To be clear"?
options: She wants to correct a mistake in her application
She thinks Ms Patel misunderstood her portfolio
She wants to make sure her request is not read as a challenge to the decision
She is angry about the result and wants an explanation
questions.evidence: not because I want to question your decision

questions.prompt: What does "came across" mean in "I wonder if it came across the way I intended"?
options: was understood by the listener
was found by chance
was written down
travelled a long distance
questions.evidence: I wonder if it came across the way I intended

questions.prompt: What does Lena offer in order to make things easier for Ms Patel?
options: To send a new portfolio
To visit the studio in person
To take a written test
A ten-minute call at a convenient time
questions.evidence: I would be happy to have a ten-minute call at a time that suits you

vocabulary.example: We are still waiting for the outcome of the vote.
She showed her portfolio of drawings at the interview.
The joke did not have the effect he intended.
I really appreciate your help with the move.

expressions.note: 邮件开头感谢对方告知结果的常用说法：Thanks for letting me know.
work to a deadline 表示“按期限完成工作”，招聘和面试里很常见。
come across as + 形容词/名词：He came across as confident.

expressions.meaning: 说明一下；我想说清楚的是
expressions.note: 用来提前消除误会，语气客气但坚定。
suit 表示“对……合适”，约时间时很礼貌：Does Friday suit you?
A position opens up 表示有空缺出现。

knowledge.quote: Although I was disappointed not to be offered the role
knowledge.explanation: not to be offered 是不定式的否定加被动：否定词 not 放在 to 前面，be offered 表示“被给予（职位）”。

knowledge.quote: I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to share some feedback on my interview.
knowledge.explanation: whether 引导宾语从句，作 ask 的宾语；would be willing to 比 will 更委婉，适合正式请求。

knowledge.quote: If a similar position opens up in the future, I hope you will consider me again.
knowledge.explanation: 真实条件句：if 从句用一般现在时 opens up 表示将来可能发生的事，主句用 will。

speaking: 用 1 分钟练习：假设你参加社团或实习面试没通过，打电话请负责人给你两点改进建议。用上 I'd like to know whether… 和 To be clear…。
writing: 用 120–150 词写一封英文邮件：一次申请（实习、社团、奖学金）没通过，请对方给一两点反馈。要感谢、说明目的、提出一个方便对方的方式，结尾留个好印象。

task.prompt: 仿照这句，用 Although I was disappointed not to …, I really … 写一句话，得体地回应一次让你失望的结果。
task.model: Although I was disappointed not to be offered the role, I really enjoyed meeting the team

title: 配音演员：用别人的口型说话
title_en: Lending a Voice: Inside a Dubbing Studio
summary_zh: 配音不只是“念台词”：每句话都要对上屏幕上演员的口型，还要演出情绪。跟着一位配音演员，看看这份“做得好就没人发现”的工作。读完你能用英语描述一份职业的难点。
body: Interviewer: What does a dubbing actor actually do? Sofia: I replace the original voices in a film or series with voices in another language, so that viewers can watch without reading subtitles. The hardest part is that my words have to fit someone else's mouth. Interviewer: Do you mean the lip movements? Sofia: Exactly. If the actor on screen opens his mouth wide, I can't use a word that keeps my lips closed, or it looks strange. The translator and I often change a line several times until it matches the picture and still sounds natural. Interviewer: How do you prepare for a role? Sofia: Usually I don't get much time, because studios work to very tight schedules. I watch each scene a few times, listen to the original performance, and then try to copy the emotion rather than the exact sound. Interviewer: Is it tiring? Sofia: More than people expect. Shouting in an action scene for an hour can leave my voice exhausted, so I drink a lot of warm water and avoid long phone calls after a session. Interviewer: What do you enjoy most? Sofia: The moment when a viewer tells me they forgot the film was dubbed. Nobody should notice my work if I've done it well. Interviewer: Any advice for someone who wants to try? Sofia: Record yourself reading aloud every day, and listen back honestly, even when it's embarrassing.

questions.prompt: What is the interview mainly about?
options: Why dubbed films are better than subtitled ones
How to become a film translator
What dubbing actors do and what makes the job difficult
The history of a famous film studio
questions.evidence: The hardest part is that my words have to fit someone else's mouth.

questions.prompt: Why does Sofia say nobody should notice her work?
options: Good dubbing feels so natural that viewers forget it is there
She is shy and does not like attention
Studios do not allow dubbing actors to be named
She works only on films that few people watch
questions.evidence: The moment when a viewer tells me they forgot the film was dubbed.

questions.prompt: What does "exhausted" mean in "leave my voice exhausted"?
options: louder than usual
very tired and unable to work well
completely silent for ever
excited and full of energy

questions.prompt: What does Sofia try to copy from the original performance?
options: the exact sound of the voice
the accent of the actor
the length of every pause
the emotion
questions.evidence: try to copy the emotion rather than the exact sound

vocabulary.example: We need to replace the old battery.
The dancer's movements were slow and careful.
Our schedules are so busy that we rarely meet.
After the long climb, everyone was exhausted.
It was embarrassing to forget his name.

expressions.meaning: 在屏幕上；在影视作品里
expressions.note: 常用于说演员的表现：She looks much taller on screen.

expressions.meaning: 按非常紧的时间表工作
expressions.note: work to a schedule / deadline 表示“按……完成”。
回答问题时先给程度，再展开，口语里很自然。
练口语的好方法：Reading aloud helps your pronunciation.
录完自己的声音再听一遍：Listen back to your recording.

knowledge.quote: If the actor on screen opens his mouth wide, I can't use a word that keeps my lips closed, or it looks strange.
knowledge.explanation: 真实条件句：if 从句和主句都用一般现在时，表示经常发生的情况；or 在这里意思是“否则”。

knowledge.quote: Shouting in an action scene for an hour can leave my voice exhausted
knowledge.explanation: 动名词短语 Shouting in an action scene for an hour 作主语；leave + 宾语 + 形容词 表示“使……处于某种状态”。

knowledge.quote: The moment when a viewer tells me they forgot the film was dubbed.
knowledge.explanation: when 引导定语从句，修饰表示时间的 The moment，相当于 at which。

speaking: 用 1 分钟说说：你喜欢看配音版还是原声加字幕？为什么？用上 rather than 和 More than people expect。
writing: 用 120–150 词介绍一份你觉得“做得好就没人注意到”的工作（如字幕、音响、校对），说说它难在哪里。用一个 If… 条件句和一个动名词作主语的句子。

task.prompt: 仿照这句，用 I try to copy … rather than … 写一句话，说说你学英语时模仿的重点。
task.model: try to copy the emotion rather than the exact sound
